title: Bias in Gender Bias Benchmarks: How Spurious Features Distort Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical reliability of gender bias benchmarks by analyzing spurious features like background and lighting. While it uses descriptors that can be associated with personality and character (e.g., 'selfish', 'loyal', 'evil'), it does so within the context of measuring gender bias and stereotypes in vision-language models, rather than evaluating religious or ethical frameworks.
